content: pgx/Go outbox pattern: durable local queue = outbox table written in the same local transaction as the business write; a separate relay process reads unpublished rows (via SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED for polling, or logical replication for push) and delivers them; delivery is at-least-once -- if publish succeeds but mark-delivered fails, the row is redelivered next cycle, so consumers/targets must dedupe via INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING or a processed-ids table, not via in-memory memoization which does not survive a relay crash.
